title: Why Amazon's Warehouses Are Now Run By Robots
closing: Robots now work in the buildings that ship your orders, right beside the people.
question: Did you expect a robot army?

segments.say: Amazon had about 1,400 warehouse robots in 2012. By 2025 that had grown to a million.
Robots began in a single Amazon building in 2012. By 2025 about 300 buildings used them.
A million robots now work beside about 1.5 million Amazon employees.
